subject.why: The table, curly white chairs, vase with a rose, and striped awning are all present and clearly recognizable.

category.why: The camera angle is flat and eye-level rather than a low camera angle that makes the object look heroic; additionally, the awning floats unnaturally in mid-air instead of being grounded in a cohesive, plausible setting.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The disconnected awning floating high above the table splits the scene into two separate objects with an awkward void between them, rather than presenting one unified central focal object.

colour.why: Colors are vibrant, saturated, and provide strong contrast against the bright blue sky.

detail.why: Shapes are clean and chunky with no noisy textures or clutter.

style.why: Matches the reference style well with smooth 3D volumes and a clean satin finish.

fix: Lower the camera angle for a more heroic perspective and connect the awning naturally over the table (such as via posts or a subtle cafe facade) so the scene reads as one unified central object rather than a floating awning separated from the furniture.
